citations.quote:
[name="黑"]Medic，我的情况怎么样？
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_016_medic",focus="m")]
[name="Medic"]和去年相比，有些发展的倾向。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_016_medic",focus="m")]
[name="Medic"]不太妙，你这两年作为教官和干员活动得有些太频繁了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_016_medic",focus="m")]
[name="Medic"]我会和上面申请，减轻你的工作负担。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_340_shwaz_1#12$1",focus="m")]
[name="黑"]那我的调任申请——
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_016_medic",focus="m")]
[name="Medic"]你回到新汐斯塔后，肯定会继续勉强自己吧？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_340_shwaz_1#12$1",focus="m")]
[name="黑"]我会好好休息。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_016_medic",focus="m")]
[name="Medic"]骗人，你都已经来罗德岛两年了，大家都了解你。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_016_medic",focus="m")]
[name="Medic"]你呀，还是太不会照顾自己了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_016_medic",focus="m")]
[name="Medic"]虽然让锡兰照顾你是最合适的，但新汐斯塔办事处现在才刚起步，至少也要等一年再让你回去我们才放心。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_340_shwaz_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="黑"]可是——
[dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_gen_walk_n")]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_348_ceylon_1#4$1",focus="m",duration=1)]
[delay(time=2)]
[name="锡兰"]那就让我来本舰照顾黑好了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_340_shwaz_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="黑"]小姐？！
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_016_medic",focus="m")]
[name="Medic"]哎呀，锡兰，你这就回来啦。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_016_medic",focus="m")]
[name="Medic"]我还想说给黑一个惊喜呢。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_348_ceylon_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="锡兰"]哎，那我不是打断你了？不好意思。
[dialog]
[playsound(key="$rungeneral")]
[charslot(duration=1)]
[delay(time=2)]
[name="门外的锡兰"]再来一次！
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_016_medic",focus="m")]
[name="Medic"]……好吧。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_016_medic",focus="m")]
[name="Medic"]咳咳。不过，黑，你也不用太担心，针对你的情况，我们有一个更好的解决方法。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_016_medic",focus="m")]
[name="Medic"]那就是——
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_348_ceylon_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="锡兰"]锵！
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_016_medic",focus="m")]
[name="Medic"]没错，在你回来后没多久，锡兰主动申请返回本舰待一段时间。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_016_medic",focus="m")]
[name="Medic"]好啦，问题解决。你们聊吧，我就不打扰了。

directions.reason: Medic为黑诊疗并熟悉她的健康与工作情况。
